newsitem.title: USA: Boston Properties to buy NYC office tower.
newsitem.headline: Boston Properties to buy NYC office tower.

text.p: Boston Properties Inc said Tuesday it signed a contract to acquire a 1.2-million-square- foot property located at 280 Park Avenue from Bankers Trust New York Corp for $321.25 million in cash.

The property, consisting of two separate buildings, is currently 88 percent leased, primarily to long-term tenants including Bankers Trust Co, Furman Selz, the National Football League, Oppenheimer & Co and Triarc Cos Inc, which together account for 677,555 square feet.
Boston Properties said it expects the deal to close in early September.

Boston Properties president and chief executive Edward Linde said, "With the acquisition of 280 Park Avenue,...we are executing plans to penetrate the growing and attractive mid-Manhattan office properties marketplace."

The company said its single largest asset is the 1.0 million-square-foot office tower at 599 Lexington Avenue in midtown Manhattan, representing about 11.5 percent of its current portfolio of 11.0 million square feet.
Boston Properties is a real estate investment trust.
